_comment: Airport registry. One entry per airport this backend serves. `schema` is the UC schema (in the bundle's catalog) that holds the airport's raw volume, bronze/silver tables and the synced Lakebase table; `hub` is the fallback airline IATA when the feed omits one. The app + generator pick an airport via env AIRPORT_IATA (default DOH) - see server/airports.py. The per-airport jobs/pipelines live in resources/airport_<iata>.yml. NOTE: only DOH has simulation geometry (taxiways/gates in data/); other airports are ingest-only until their geodata is added.
